content.title: program snapshot
points: Learn from the top industry professionals

curriculum.title: EDA & Data Storytelling
points: Scientific Exploration of Industry Data (Case Study)

curriculum.title: Minor Capstone Project
points: In a simulated environment, you get to work with a major Telecom company that seeks help from your team of Data Scientists to resolve a major marketing hurdle. Get a near real world exposure of working on industry problems within data science teams.

curriculum.title: Machine Learning Intermediate
points: Dimensionality Reduction using Principle Component Analysis

curriculum.title: Major Capstone Project
points: Experience a real world simulation of a company Employee Retention Program that needs to be solved using Data Science and Machine Learning. Work with a team of Data Scientists and experience real-world problem solving through Data Science

curriculum.title: Introduction to Product Management
points: Roles & Responsibilities of a Product Manager (PM)

curriculum.title: Design Thinking & UI/UX
points: Building MVP - Artefacts, Persona Mapping & PRDs

curriculum.title: Agile Product Engineering
points: Introduction to Engineering for Product Managers

curriculum.title: Product Marketing & Launch
points: Measuring Brand & Impact of Product Marketing

curriculum.title: Design Discovery
points: Design Discovery requires one to apply design thinking concepts to create human-centred and action-oriented solutions. As a PM practitioner you will be competing with the best to solve a complex challenge.

content.title: 1.Is prior experience in Data Science or Product Management required for program enrollment?
content: No, the program is designed to be inclusive of all levels of experience. All topics will be covered from the basics, making it suitable for individuals from any field of work.

content.title: 2.What is the minimum system configuration required?
content: Any latest processor (i3/i5/i7) with 2.0GHz clock speed and RAM 4GB (required), 8GB(recommended).

content.title: How many projects can I anticipate working on?
content: In the Executive Program in Data Science and Product Management, you will have access to three projects: a Minor Capstone Project, a Major Project, and Mission: Design Discovery, to provide a better understanding of the real-world applications of Data Science and Product Management concepts.

content.title: What's the difference between case studies & projects?
content: Case studies are targeted towards concept validation and limited to only a single concept. However, projects are targeted to overall learning and are more of a combination of multiple topics.

content.title: What all topics are covered in the Executive Program in Data Science and Product Management Program?
How much time does one need to spend on a regular basis?
content: Ideally, 30 minutes of preparation time is recommended each day, but students can allocate time according to their own schedules. They can choose to practice, read, or watch videos. Additionally, students must attend live classes on weekends. The schedule for these classes will be shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: The duration of the program is 11 months, every term is approximately 4-5 weeks long.

content.title: How is the Executive Program in Data Science & Product Management program different?
content: ## This program is distinguished by three key elements:

- **Iterative Mastery Approach:** IITG's exclusive Iterative Mastery Approach ensures development through a step-by-step methodology, specifically designed to welcome individuals from diverse backgrounds. Whether you're seeking a lateral move in the industry or looking to broaden your skills, our program is tailored to empower you on your unique learning journey.

- **Versatile Skill Development Model:** IITG's unique framework ensures that every Data Science and Product Management concept is taught in the context of real-world industry problems. Our program goes beyond theory, emphasizing practical case studies to prepare students for the challenges they'll face in the professional arena.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: Accredian provides career assistance through the Career Launchpad program. Students gain hands-on experience as leaders in their chosen field with rigorous resume and portfolio building sessions. The program also covers creating a strong online presence and developing top-notch interview skills.
